unlisted_practices: Exercise caution when using LLM tools in clinical settings or direct patient care.
Independently verify results from LLM tools before relying on them.
Do not enter patient personal health information into LLM tools that are not covered by HIPAA protections.
Understand when and how EHR systems use LLM tools and be prepared to answer patient questions about them.
Weigh the benefits and risks of new LLM tools before integrating them into workflow.

screen.reason: This is a commentary/guideline article introducing AI scribes in psychiatry and providing recommendations for responsible integration and governance.
